I’ve been using the Groww App for mutual fund investments, but I’m quite disappointed with a major concern that hasn’t been addressed.

Groww is directly storing mutual fund units in DEMAT format without taking proper consent or providing clear choice to investors regarding their preferred holding format — whether DEMAT or SOA (Statement of Account).

Many investors prefer SOA format as it gives more flexibility (especially for switching platforms or offline transactions) and avoids unnecessary DP charges. However, Groww doesn’t offer an option to choose and automatically links all investments to the DEMAT account held with them.

This is not just a matter of user experience, but an important investment decision, and Groww must take explicit consent from the investor before choosing the holding format. For a platform that claims to be investor-friendly, this is quite disappointing.

I hope Groww takes this feedback seriously and starts providing the option to select the holding mode during mutual fund investment – the way other platforms like Sharekhan or MF Central do.

1) Mandate (AutoPay) Limits  
Currently, AutoPay mandate is quite restrictive:  
- UPI mandate is limited (generally up to ₹1–2 lakh depending on bank)  
- Net banking mandate allows only up to around ₹5 lakh  
- Default practical usage often stays near ₹1 lakh for seamless transactions  

Because of this, it becomes very difficult for serious investors to invest large lump sum amounts.

For example:  
- If I want to invest ₹10 lakh or more in one go during market correction, it is not possible smoothly using mandate  
- I have to split transactions or use manual payment, which defeats the purpose of AutoPay  

Other platforms like NJ Wealth provide higher mandate flexibility (₹20–50 lakh or more), which is much more practical for high-value investors.

👉 Request:  
Please introduce higher mandate limits (₹20–50 lakh or customizable based on user profile and bank approval), especially via net banking/eMandate.

---

2) Limited SIP Frequency Options  
Currently, SIP options are limited to monthly (and some dates).  

👉 Missing features:  
- Daily SIP option  
- Weekly SIP option  

These are very useful for:  
- Better cost averaging  
- Investing during volatile markets  
- More flexible cash flow management  

Many investors prefer daily/weekly SIP to capture market movements more effectively.

---

✅ Overall:  
Groww is a very user-friendly and excellent platform, but these limitations make it less suitable for high-value and advanced investors.

Improving mandate limits and adding flexible SIP frequencies will significantly enhance the platform experience.
